::: {#exm-mae-gaussian}
#### Mean absolute error of a Gaussian estimator

Suppose an estimator $\hth$ has a Gaussian distribution
with mean $\th$ and standard deviation $\tau$,
so that its estimation error $\erf{\hth} = \hth - \th$
has the same distribution as $\tau Z$,
where $Z$ has a standard Gaussian distribution
with density $\phi(z) = (2\pi)^{-1/2} e^{-z^2/2}$.
Then:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\maelr{\hth}
&= \E{\abs{\tau Z}}
&& \text{(definition of MAE)}\\
&= \E{\tau \abs{Z}}
&& \text{($\abs{\tau Z} = \tau \abs{Z}$ because $\tau > 0$)}\\
&= \tau \E{\abs{Z}}
&& \text{(factor the constant $\tau$ out of the expectation)}\\
&= \tau \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} \abs{z} \phi(z) \, dz
&& \text{(expectation of a function of $Z$)}\\
&= \tau \cdot 2 \int_{0}^{\infty} \abs{z} \phi(z) \, dz
&& \text{($\abs{z}\phi(z)$ is symmetric about 0)}\\
&= \tau \cdot 2 \int_{0}^{\infty} z \phi(z) \, dz
&& \text{($\abs{z} = z$ for $z \ge 0$)}\\
&= \tau \cdot 2 \sb{-\phi(z)}_{0}^{\infty}
&& \text{($\phi'(z) = -z\phi(z)$)}\\
&= \tau \cdot 2 \paren{\lim_{z \to \infty} \sb{-\phi(z)} - \paren{-\phi(0)}}
&& \text{(evaluate at the limits)}\\
&= \tau \cdot 2 \paren{\lim_{z \to \infty} \sb{-\phi(z)} + \phi(0)}
&& \text{(subtracting a negative is adding)}\\
&= \tau \cdot 2 \paren{0 + \phi(0)}
&& \text{($\phi(z) \to 0$ as $z \to \infty$)}\\
&= \tau \cdot 2 \phi(0)
&& \text{(drop the zero term)}\\
&= \tau \cdot 2 (2\pi)^{-1/2}
&& \text{($\phi(0) = (2\pi)^{-1/2}$)}\\
&= \tau \cdot 2 \cdot \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}}
&& \text{(write $(2\pi)^{-1/2}$ as $1/\sqrt{2\pi}$)}\\
&= \tau \cdot \frac{2}{\sqrt{2\pi}}
&& \text{(multiply)}\\
&= \tau \cdot \frac{\sqrt{4}}{\sqrt{2\pi}}
&& \text{(write $2$ as $\sqrt{4}$)}\\
&= \tau \sqrt{4/(2\pi)}
&& \text{(quotient of square roots)}\\
&= \tau \sqrt{2/\pi}
&& \text{(cancel the common factor 2 in $4/(2\pi)$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

So for an [unbiased](#def-unbiased) Gaussian estimator,
the mean absolute error is about $0.80$ times the standard deviation $\tau$,
while the [root mean squared error](#def-rmse) is $\tau$ itself
(@thm-unbiased-props).
:::
